sentences.text: Donald Hugh `` Don '' Henley -LRB- born July 22 , 1947 -RRB- is an American singer-songwriter , producer , and drummer , best known as a founding member of the Eagles before launching a successful solo career .	producer	Record producer	Eagles	Eagles (band)	singer-songwriter	singer-songwriter	drummer	drummer
Henley was the drummer and co-lead singer for the Eagles from 1971 to 1980 , when the band broke up , and from 1994 to 2016 , when they reunited .	Eagles	Eagles (band)	drummer	drummer

Henley sang the lead vocals on Eagles hits such as `` Witchy Woman '' , `` Desperado '' , `` Best of My Love '' , `` One of These Nights '' , `` Hotel California '' , `` Life in the Fast Lane '' , `` The Long Run '' and `` Get Over It '' .	Eagles	Eagles (band)	Witchy Woman	Witchy Woman	Desperado	Desperado (song)	Best of My Love	Best of My Love (Eagles song)	One of These Nights	One of These Nights (song)	Hotel California	Hotel California	Life in the Fast Lane	Life in the Fast Lane	The Long Run	The Long Run (song)	Get Over It	Get Over It (Eagles song)
After the Eagles broke up in 1980 , Henley pursued a solo career and released his debut album I Ca n't Stand Still , in 1982 .	Eagles	Eagles (band)
He has released five studio albums , two compilation albums , and one live DVD .

His solo hits include `` Dirty Laundry '' , `` The Boys of Summer '' , `` All She Wants to Do Is Dance '' , `` The Heart of the Matter '' , `` The Last Worthless Evening '' , `` Sunset Grill '' , `` Not Enough Love in the World '' , and `` The End of the Innocence '' .	Dirty Laundry	Dirty Laundry (Don Henley song)	The Boys of Summer	The Boys of Summer (song)	All She Wants to Do Is Dance	All She Wants to Do Is Dance	The Heart of the Matter	The Heart of the Matter (song)	The Last Worthless Evening	The Last Worthless Evening	Sunset Grill	Sunset Grill (song)	Not Enough Love in the World	Not Enough Love in the World	The End of the Innocence	The End of the Innocence (song)
The Eagles have sold over 150 million albums worldwide , won six Grammy Awards , had five No. 1 singles , 17 Top 40 singles , and six No. 1 albums .	Eagles	Eagles (band)	Grammy Awards	Grammy Awards
They were inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 1998 and are the biggest selling American band in history .	Rock	Rock music	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

As a solo artist , Henley has sold over 10 million albums worldwide , had eight Top 40 singles , won two Grammy Awards and five MTV Video Music Awards .	Grammy Awards	Grammy Awards	MTV Video Music Awards	MTV Video Music Awards
Combined with the Eagles and as a solo artist , Henley has released 25 Top 40 singles on the Billboard Hot 100 .	Eagles	Eagles (band)
He has also released seven studio albums with the Eagles and four as a solo artist .	Eagles	Eagles (band)
In 2008 , he was ranked as the 87th greatest singer of all time by the Rolling Stone magazine .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone
Henley has also played a founding role in several environmental and political causes , most notably the Walden Woods Project .	Walden Woods Project	Walden Woods Project
From 1994 to 2016 , he divided his musical activities between the Eagles and his solo career .	Eagles	Eagles (band)
